title: Rare-variant genetic architecture of height in over 1.4 million individuals
description:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11345-2

Analysis of exomes from over 1.4 million participants implicates 207 genes, including large effect coding variants and gene burden tests, and demonstrates the utility of large-scale sequencing for trait prediction and variant interpretation.
